QF.id: VIII Introduction to Clearing and Settlement System_17

question.text: Exposure margin in equity derivatives serves the purpose of:

answer.text: Providing an additional safety cushion over and above the initial margin to cover potential mark-to-market losses
Providing funds for the settlement guarantee fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Exposure margins apply the Capital Market segment VaR and Extreme Loss percentages on client-level settlement obligations and are levied in addition to initial margins. They function as a second line of defence against adverse market moves between margin computations. The Trap: Exposure margin does not replace initial margin; it is over and above it. Total margin obligation = initial (SPAN) margin + exposure margin. Note: Source: NISM-Series-VIII workbook (Dec 2025), pages 162-163.
